observations: Dataset, dimension and budget controls are readable and display the matching 102,000-target denominator.
The point and lower-envelope curves use distinct colors and solid/dashed styles.
All five charts retain readable axis labels at mobile size through intentional horizontal scrolling.
The visible lower-envelope curve sacrifices recall and F1 at the displayed thresholds; precision and accuracy are not presented as universally better or worse.
The report explicitly distinguishes pooled repeated occurrences from equal-cell AUROC and seed-sensitivity intervals.
scroll_validation: interaction_validation.json verifies all five mobile charts can scroll across their full width.
